    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    fits = bins >= item
    remaining = bins - item
    load_ratio = (bins - remaining) / np.where(bins > 0, bins, 1)
    sigmoid = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-10 * (load_ratio - 0.5)))
    fit_quality = np.where(fits, 1 / (1 + remaining), 0)
    priorities = sigmoid * fit_quality
    priorities = np.where(fits, priorities, -np.inf)
    return priorities
